flags.sold_over_meter: Sold more than the meter shows

setup.title: Forecourt set-up
setup.description: Stations, fuel products, tanks, pumps and nozzles, and the tolerances of each company.

stations.description: A station is a location marked as a forecourt. Its prices and shifts use the station’s currency.
stations.help: Pick the location that is a forecourt and the currency its prices use. Change the currency before the first price or shift only.
stations.empty: No stations yet. Create one from a location to start.
stations.archiveHelp: An archived station stays in the records but takes no new prices or shifts. A station with an open shift can’t be archived: close the shift first.

products.description: A fuel product is a stock item sold by the litre, with a fuel type and an optional grade.
products.help: Pick a stock item whose base unit is the litre. Create the item in the catalogue first if it is not there.
products.gradeHelp: For example Super or V-Power. Optional.
products.empty: No fuel products yet. Mark a stock item as fuel to start.
products.archiveHelp: An archived product can’t be given a new tank or price. Archive its tanks first.

tanks.description: Each tank holds one fuel product at one station. Open a tank for its calibration charts and book stock.
tanks.toleranceHelp: Leave empty to use the company’s tolerance from the settings tab.
tanks.empty: No tanks yet. Create a tank at a station to start.

pumps.description: A pump has one or more nozzles. Each nozzle draws from one tank of the same station.
pumps.empty: No pumps yet. Create a pump at a station to start.
pumps.archiveHelp: Archive the pump’s nozzles first. A pump with an active nozzle can’t be archived.

nozzles.help: Pick the tank this nozzle draws from. Its product is the tank’s product.
nozzles.empty: This pump has no nozzles yet.
nozzles.caption: Nozzles of pump {{pump}}
nozzles.archiveHelp: A nozzle on an open shift can’t be archived: close the shift first.

settings.description: Tolerances of {{company}}. A difference within them is accepted without approval.
settings.toConfirm: All tolerances start at zero, so every difference needs approval. None is built in: set the values your company accepts.
settings.noCompany: There is no company to set up yet. Create a company first.
settings.cashToleranceHelp: The cash a settlement may be short or over before it needs approval.
settings.litreToleranceHelp: The litres the meter may differ from the recorded sales on a shift.
settings.lossPercentHelp: As a percent of the litres sold since the last baseline.
settings.lossLitresHelp: The larger of this and the percent applies.
settings.testLitres: Pump test allowance per nozzle in litres
settings.testLitresHelp: Pump tests above this on a nozzle send the shift to approval. Zero means every test is reviewed.
settings.deliveryPercentHelp: As a percent of the litres on the delivery note.

tank.notFound: This tank doesn’t exist or isn’t at a station you can see. Go back to the tanks and pick another.
tank.archived: This tank is archived. It stays in the records but takes no new dips or deliveries.
tank.archiveHelp: A tank with an active nozzle can’t be archived. Archive or re-link the nozzles first.
tank.chartsHelp: Each chart converts a dip in cm to litres. The chart in force at the time of a dip is the one used. A chart can’t be changed: add a new one.
tank.chartsEmpty: This tank has no calibration chart yet, so dips can’t be converted. Add a chart.

chart.help: Enter the dip in cm and the litres at that dip, from the tank’s strapping table. Both columns must rise from one row to the next, and no row may be above the tank’s capacity.

problems.tooFew: A chart needs at least two rows. Add a row.
problems.notRising: Each dip and each volume must be above the row before. Correct the rows that go down or repeat.
problems.aboveCapacity: A row is above the tank’s capacity. Correct the litres or the tank’s capacity.

preview.title: Dip to litres
preview.help: Try a dip against the chart in force. Nothing is recorded.

prices.title: Fuel prices
prices.description: The price per litre at each station and product. A price has a start time and can’t be changed once saved.
prices.regulated: Regulated prices are typed here from the regulator’s notice. None is built in: enter the price and its reference yourself.
prices.help: A new price starts at the time you give, or now. It can’t start in the past.
prices.pickStation: Pick a station first: the price is in its currency.
prices.effectiveHelp: Leave empty to start now. A later time schedules the price.
prices.referenceHelp: For example the regulator’s notice number.
prices.emptyCurrent: No price is in force yet. Add the first price of a product at a station.
prices.withdrawHelp: Only a price that has not started can be withdrawn. The record stays and shows who withdrew it.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Attendant shifts at your stations, with meter readings and collections.
shifts.empty: No shifts yet. Shifts appear here when a till opens one.
shifts.emptyFiltered: No shifts match these filters. Widen the period or clear a filter.

shift.notFound: This shift doesn’t exist or isn’t at a station you can see. Go back to the shifts and pick another.
shift.title: Shift at {{station}}
shift.nozzlesHelp: Litres by meter are the closing reading minus the opening reading, minus pump tests, plus approved resets. Unrecorded litres are the meter litres no sale accounts for.
shift.noSettlements: No attendant has handed in yet. The settlements appear when the shift closes.

sales.title: Fuel sales
sales.description: Sales of fuel at your stations. A flag marks a sale that needs a look; no sale is refused.
sales.empty: No fuel sales yet. Sales appear here when a till rings fuel.
sales.emptyFiltered: No fuel sales match these filters. Widen the period or clear a filter.

settlements.title: Variance review
settlements.description: What each attendant handed in against what the meters say. A station manager approves the ones outside tolerance.
settlements.empty: No settlements match these filters. Clear a filter or widen the period.

settlement.notFound: This settlement doesn’t exist or isn’t at a station you can see. Go back to the list and pick another.
settlement.tendersHelp: Cash is what the attendant counted. Other tenders are what the sales recorded.
settlement.reopenedHelp: A sale reached the server after the shift closed, so the figures were recalculated.
settlement.whoApprovesHelp: The attendant, the person who opened the shift and the person who closed it can’t approve it, whatever their roles. Approvals are decided in the approvals inbox.

reconciliations.title: Tank reconciliations
reconciliations.description: The dip of each tank against the book stock. A difference outside tolerance waits for a station manager.
reconciliations.empty: No reconciliations match these filters. Clear a filter or widen the period.

reconciliation.notFound: This reconciliation doesn’t exist or isn’t at a station you can see. Go back to the list and pick another.
reconciliation.figuresHelp: Expected is the baseline plus deliveries minus sales. The variance is the dip minus expected: negative is a loss, positive a gain.
reconciliation.whoApprovesHelp: The person who took the dip can’t approve it, whatever their role. Approvals are decided in the approvals inbox.

resets.title: Meter resets
resets.description: When a pump meter is replaced or rolls over, a reset moves the nozzle’s baseline. A person other than the requester approves it.
resets.help: Enter the last reading before the change and the first reading after it, and say why.
resets.shiftHelp: Pick the shift the nozzle is on, if one is open. The litres before the change are added to it.
resets.notLower: The reading after a reset can’t be above the reading before it. Check both readings.
resets.empty: No meter resets match these filters.
resets.emptyPending: No reset is waiting for approval.

dips.title: Tank dips
dips.description: Dips of each tank in cm, converted to litres by the calibration chart in force.
dips.help: Enter the dip as read on the stick, in cm. The server converts it to litres and checks the tank against its book stock.
dips.waterHelp: Optional. The water at the bottom of the tank, in cm.
dips.noReconciliation: This dip doesn’t reconcile the tank.

outcome.baseline: This is the tank’s first dip, so it only sets the baseline. Reconciliation starts with the next dip.
outcome.accepted: The difference is within tolerance, so the dip is accepted and the baseline moves to it.
outcome.pending_approval: The difference is outside tolerance, so the dip waits for a station manager. You can’t approve your own dip.

dips.empty: No dips yet. Record the first dip of a tank to set its baseline.
dips.emptyFiltered: No dips match these filters. Widen the period or clear a filter.

deliveries.title: Fuel deliveries
deliveries.description: Fuel received into the tanks. The stock is posted from what the dips measured, not from the note.
deliveries.help: Dip the tank before and after offloading. Received is the dip after minus the dip before, plus the litres sold while offloading.
deliveries.pickTank: Pick a tank first: the cost is in its station’s currency.
deliveries.unitCostHelp: What you paid per litre. Stock is valued at it.
deliveries.shortageHelp: The delivery is recorded as measured. Claim the shortage from the supplier outside this module.
deliveries.empty: No deliveries yet. Record the first one when a tanker offloads.
deliveries.emptyFiltered: No deliveries match these filters. Widen the period or clear a filter.

delivery.notFound: This delivery doesn’t exist or isn’t at a station you can see. Go back to the deliveries and pick another.
delivery.figuresHelp: A delivery can’t be changed. A mistake is corrected with a stock adjustment.

vehicles.title: Fleet vehicles
vehicles.description: Vehicles of credit customers. A credit sale checks the vehicle’s fuel type and daily limit.
vehicles.label: Label
vehicles.labelHelp: For example the driver or the route. Optional.
vehicles.fuelTypeHelp: A sale of another fuel type is flagged.
vehicles.blocked: Blocked: a credit sale to this vehicle is flagged
vehicles.empty: No vehicles yet. Add a customer’s vehicle to track fleet sales.
vehicles.emptyFiltered: No vehicles match. Clear the search or the archived filter.
vehicles.archiveHelp: An archived vehicle is unknown to new credit sales. Its past sales stay in the records.

vouchers.title: Fuel vouchers
vouchers.description: Prepaid fuel value. A voucher is spent at the till as a payment and its balance goes down.
vouchers.help: Set the value in one currency. The voucher can only be spent in that currency.
vouchers.fuelTypeHelp: Leave on any fuel to allow every fuel type.
vouchers.expiresHelp: Optional. The last day the voucher can be spent.
vouchers.empty: No vouchers yet. Issue the first one.
vouchers.emptyFiltered: No vouchers match. Clear the search or the status filter.

voucher.notFound: This voucher doesn’t exist or isn’t in a company you can see. Go back to the vouchers and pick another.
voucher.noRedemptions: This voucher has not been spent yet.
voucher.voidHelp: A void voucher can’t be spent. Its redemptions stay in the records.

reports.title: Fuel reports
reports.empty: Nothing to show for this period. Widen the period or clear a filter.
reports.periodHelp: Leave both dates empty for the last 30 days.
reports.resets: Meter resets decided in the period

shift-summary.title: Shift summary
shift-summary.help: Each shift with its litres, expected, collected and variance.

attendant-variance.title: Attendant variance
attendant-variance.help: Collections against expected per attendant over the period.

nozzle-meter-history.title: Nozzle meter history
nozzle-meter-history.help: Every opening and closing reading, with resets and gaps.

tank-reconciliation.title: Tank losses and gains
tank-reconciliation.help: Every reconciliation of the period, and the losses and gains per tank.

sales-by-product.title: Sales by product
sales-by-product.help: Litres and value per product and station.

fleet-statement.title: Fleet statement
fleet-statement.help: Fleet and credit sales per customer and vehicle.
